messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: streaming-decode-p99 spike in us-west-2 (clusters decode-prod-{a,b,c}) — p99 1.8s -> 6.2s over last 8m. Alert threshold breached. @here

maria: picking this up, oncall. seeing the same in dashboards. p95 up ~900ms, p99 much worse. any recent deploys to decode nodes? :eyes:

irene: we pushed a kernel/toolchain roll (trt8-flashattn build) to canary 18m ago, then promoted to prod ~12m ago. change-list: trt8-2026-03-12 + flashattn-v2.1 + new compile flags `-march=sm90 -Ofast`

aj: confirming — CI shows new decoder kernels went live at 12:07 UTC. no other infra changes.

maria: ok, likely correlated. are stalls due to compilepath paging regressions or kernel evictions? any OOMs in dmesg?

irene: kernel logs show increased pagefaults on NVRAM-backed KV cache during long sequences. not hard OOMs but lots of vmfaults and longer stall cycles. stack traces point to new memcpy kernel path used by the TRT flash-attn patch.

aj: running an immediate quick mitigation: route 30% of traffic to fallback model variant (decode-compat-v1) and 70% to current. will update routing policy in 1m.

maria: do it and monitor p95/p99. also notify support+status that we might start customer-impact mitigation.

deploy-bot: routing change applied: traffic split set to 30% decode-compat-v1 / 70% decode-prod.

maria: good. Irene — can we hot-rollback the trt8 kernel to previous build (trt8-2026-02-28) on the three clusters? That should revert memcpy path.

irene: rolling back on cluster-a first now. using kexec rollback playbook: `./ops/kernels/rollback.sh --target decode-prod-a --image trt8-2026-02-28`

(10:38) irene: rollback started on decode-prod-a. will watch tail logs.

(10:40) aj: customer traffic on fallback variant shows lower p99 but slightly lower throughput per-GPU. still acceptable for degraded-mode.

(10:44) deploy-bot: kernel rollback completed on decode-prod-a. warm restart of runtime containers triggered.

maria: checking metrics… p99 on cluster-a dropped from 6.1s -> 1.1s within 30s of rollback :tada: Looks promising.

irene: starting rollback on cluster-b now. planning staggered to avoid region-wide flapping.

aj: can we temporarily increase prefix/KV cache retention and disable aggressive eviction to reduce pagewalks while we finish rollbacks? That might help streaming tails.

irene: yes, can toggle `kv_cache.eviction_threshold` from 0.6 -> 0.85 in runtime config across nodes. doing cluster-b now.

(10:58) irene: cluster-b rollback finished. cluster-c rollback in progress. cluster-c scheduled 5m behind to watch for regressions.

maria: ops note for postmortem: probable root cause = new memcpy/attention kernel path in trt8-flashattn-v2.1 interacting badly with our NVRAM-backed prefix cache, causing pagefault-induced stalls during long decode sequences and boosting p99.

tom: flagging customer comms — product suggests posting a short status update noting degraded performance for streaming endpoints and that a rollback is in progress. want me to draft?

maria: yes, please. include affected regions (us-west-2), ETA for full rollback (~+15m), and mitigation (traffic split + rollbacks).

(11:05) deploy-bot: cluster-c rollback complete. all three clusters on trt8-2026-02-28.

maria: rerunning metrics — global p99 for streaming decode down to 1.0s, p95 back to 350ms. removing immediate page of customers. will keep traffic split for 10m then move back to 100% prod once stable.

aj: opening an urgent PR to add a canary hold for future kernel/toolchain promotions: `ci/promote_kernels.md` with mandatory 30m traffic canary and pageback checks for pagefaults.

maria: also adding a temporary guard to runtime that rejects the `-Ofast` flag combination for our compile pipeline until we validate on long sequences. create an RFC?

irene: will capture logs and build repro. planning to run long-sequence stress tests against flashattn-v2.1 in staging overnight (100k+ tokens sequences) to exercise paging.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria. Severity set to Sev2. Incident timeline created.

maria: handoff to next oncall (aj) at 11:20 UTC. keep monitoring for regressions. please collect kernel logs, `dmesg`, `runtime` trace, and perf counters for postmortem. attach to incident ticket.

aj: taking handoff. summary for next shift: root cause likely memcpy/attention kernel path in trt8-flashattn-v2.1 causing pagefault stalls on NVRAM KV cache; immediate mitigation = rollback kernels + routing split + eviction threshold increase; status = all clusters rolled back, metrics stable. next steps = stress test, CI canary changes, runtime guard, postmortem + customer comms.

maria: thanks team. great quick coordination. follow-up owners: irene (runtime repro & fix), aj (CI guard + canary PR), tom (customer/status comm), maria (postmortem writeup).

(11:19) irene: attaching relevant commands I used for trace:```bash
# fetch dmesg since promotion
journalctl -u kernel.service --since "2026-03-12 12:00" | grep -i pagefault -A5
# rollback command
./ops/kernels/rollback.sh --target decode-prod-{a,b,c} --image trt8-2026-02-28 --stagger 300
# toggle eviction
./ops/runtime/configure.sh --set kv_cache.eviction_threshold=0.85 --target decode-prod-*
```

maria: adding note to incident ticket: do not re-promote trt8-flashattn-v2.1 until repro & perf regression fixed.

aj: will take over monitoring for next 2h. if p99 creeps >1.5s, escalate to SEV1.

maria: handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
